data.name: Jaleesah
data.gender_notes: Jaleesah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'jalasa', meaning 'to be gentle, kind, or beautiful'. In Islamic tradition, Jaleesah signifies the gentle and graceful nature of Allah, reflecting His infinite compassion and mercy towards His creation. The name Jaleesah carries the meaning “Graceful, gentle, beautiful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jaleesah usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, gentle, beautiful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name rich in spiritual symbolism, Jaleesah represents the gentle and compassionate nature of Allah, inspiring love, kindness, and grace in those who bear it.
data.etymology: Jaleesah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Graceful, gentle, beautiful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jaleesah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

A name often given to girls, Jaleesah is a reminder of the importance of maintaining grace and gentleness, especially in interpersonal relationships and communication.

As mentioned in the Quran, Allah is "The Most Merciful of the Merciful" (Ar-Rahman Ar-Rahim), and it is believed that invoking such a gentle, kind, and compassionate name will bring peace, comfort, and forgiveness to those who call on it. In times of hardship or adversity, the name Jaleesah serves as a reminder that even in the midst of life's challenges, Allah continues to show endless love and compassion to His creation.
